postcode.title: Where is the gas connection?
postcode.description: Enter the postcode of the connection to find its gas distribution network operator. Leave it blank to pick the region and the operator yourself.

unpriced_network.title: Part of this postcode is not covered
unpriced_network.description: Part of postcode {postcode} is supplied through {operators}, a network no Belgian tariff card prices, so this integration cannot bill it. Continue only if your gas comes through {dsos}.

region.title: Region
region.description: The region decides the network operators and the levies on the bill.

contract.title: Contract
contract.description: The product you are on. The dates are optional: a contract start date bills a fixed or indexed contract at the card of the month it was signed, and the tariff card month overrides that month when the card you signed is from another month. The end date only feeds a renewal reminder.

data.ytd_from_contract_start: Count this year's cost from the contract start

data_description.tariff_card_date: Any day of the month of the card you signed, when it is not the month supply started.
data_description.ytd_from_contract_start: Off: the running cost starts on 1 January. On: it starts at the contract start date when that is later.

dso.title: Network operator
dso.description: The gas distribution network operator of the connection. It sets the network part of the bill.

household.title: Household
household.description: Your yearly gas use picks the distribution tier and the excise slices until your meter has measured a full year. The gas meter feeds the running costs; leave it blank to use the one in the Energy dashboard.

data.conversion_mode: Convert cubic metres to kWh with
data.daily_compare: Compare every contract once a day

data_description.annual_consumption_kwh: In kWh, as printed on your last yearly bill.
data_description.caliber: The Brussels levy depends on the meter's maximum flow, printed on the meter (G4 and G6 meters are 6 or 10 m³/h).
data_description.gas_meter: A cumulative gas sensor in m³ or kWh.
data_description.conversion_mode: The factor on your bill is the one your network operator bills with. The station's calorific value leaves out the operator's correction for the pressure and temperature at the meter and counts up to a few percent more kWh: pick it when you have no bill at hand.
data_description.card_archive: When a supplier's card cannot be read, use the last card the project's daily archive captured. The request names the supplier and the contract and nothing else.
data_description.daily_compare: Fetches the cards of every supplier in your region once a day and publishes the best saving as a sensor.

station.title: Gas reception station
station.description: The network operator converts cubic metres to kWh with the calorific value of the reception station your connection is fed from, published monthly by Atrias. It leaves out the operator's correction for the pressure and temperature at the meter, so it counts up to a few percent more kWh than your bill. Pick the station closest to you; some bills name it.

factor.title: Conversion factor
factor.description: The kWh one cubic metre of your gas is worth, as printed on your bill (about 11 to 12 kWh/m³ since the switch to high-calorific gas). Leave it empty to pick your reception station instead.

user.title: Where is the gas connection?
user.description: Enter the postcode of the connection to find its gas distribution network operator. Leave it blank to pick the region and the operator yourself.

signed_rate.title: Signing rate
signed_rate.description: Only for a contract whose figures differ from the supplier's card for its signing month, or whose card the archive cannot reach: leave empty otherwise. Price and base in c€/kWh excluding VAT, the factor in c€/kWh per €/MWh of index (a formula printed in €/MWh, such as "ZTP x 1,010 + 2,160", is a factor of 0,1010 and a base of 0,2160), the fee in € a year including VAT.

custom_energy.title: Your contract's energy price
custom_energy.description: Type the figures of your contract as your card or bill prints them, including VAT. You keep them current: there is no card to refresh.

data.custom_fee: Supplier fixed fee (€ a year, incl. VAT)

custom_network.title: Your network operator's tariff
custom_network.description: The regulated figures of your network operator and the levies, including VAT, as a card for your region prints them. Distribution tiers: T1 up to 5 000 kWh a year, T2 up to 150 000. The excise, the energy contribution and the Walloon connection fee follow the law for the months the integration knows it; what you type for them counts outside those months.

data.custom_metering: Metering or data management (€ a year)
data.custom_levy: Brussels per-meter levy for your meter (€ a year)

compare.title: Compare another contract
compare.description: Pick the supplier to quote against your own contract.

compare_contract.title: Contract to quote
compare_contract.description: Both contracts are priced for your household: your annual volume, network operator and tier, on each card as published today.

compare_result.title: Quote
compare_result.description:
A year of {annual_kwh} kWh on each card as published today, all costs included. A dagger marks a provisional price, at the last index value the supplier published or at the price its card prints where it publishes none, which the month may still move. OCR marks a card published as images, priced on the card archive's reading of it.

{table}

compare_all_result.title: Every contract, ranked
compare_all_result.description:
A year of {annual_kwh} kWh on every card sold in your region as published today, cheapest first, your own contract in bold. A dagger marks a provisional price, at the last index value the supplier published or at the price its card prints where it publishes none. OCR marks a card published as images, priced on the card archive's reading of it. Not reached within the time budget: {skipped}.

{table}

snapshot_stale.title: {supplier} tariff card is out of date

confirm.title: {supplier} tariff card is out of date
confirm.description: The card {entry} prices on has not been refreshed for a week, or is for a month that has ended, so the prices may be wrong. Last error: {error}. Press submit to fetch it again now.

extractor_failed.title: {supplier} tariff card could not be read
extractor_failed.description: The card for {entry} failed to parse twice in a row: {error}. The last good card keeps pricing. If this persists the supplier probably changed its layout; please open an issue with the diagnostics.

card_unreadable.title: {supplier} publishes its card as images
card_unreadable.description: The card for {entry} has no text layer, so it cannot be read. The last good card, or the project's card archive, keeps pricing.

card_read_by_ocr.title: {supplier} card read from its image
card_read_by_ocr.description: {supplier} publishes the card of {entry} as page images. The project's card archive reads it every day with an OCR engine that knows the fonts these cards are set in, and {entry} prices on that reading: a line on which the engine was not sure of a mark is left out rather than guessed. The federal levies and the Walloon connection fee are billed from the law. This clears by itself when the supplier publishes a readable card again.

meter_unit.title: Gas meter cannot be read
meter_unit.description: The gas meter of {entry} cannot be used: {error}. The running costs stay unknown until it is fixed.

several_meters.title: Several gas meters in the Energy dashboard
several_meters.description: The Energy dashboard lists {count} gas meters and {entry} bills the first one. Set the gas meter in the integration's options to choose.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Fetch the tariff card and the index values again now.

entry_id.name: Entry
entry_id.description: Only this entry; all entries when left out.

backfill_statistics.name: Backfill price history
backfill_statistics.description: Write the price sensors' hourly statistics from a start date to now.

entry_id.name: Entry
entry_id.description: Only this entry; all entries when left out.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: Defaults to the start of the year's window. Never before a change of contract recorded this year.

clear.name: Clear first
clear.description: Deletes the sensors' statistics in full before writing; needs an entry.

unknown_entry.message: No loaded Belgian Gas Prices entry has the id {entry_id}.

clear_needs_entry.message: Clearing statistics needs an entry: it deletes them in full.
